15:1.text: These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān

15:2.text: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish

15:3.text: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by
hope, for they are going to know.

15:4.text: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.

15:5.text: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

15:6.text: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.

15:7.text: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"

15:8.text: We do not send down the angels except with truth;

15:9.text: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message
, and indeed, We will be its guardian.

15:10.text: , among the sects of the former peoples.

15:11.text: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.

15:12.text: into the hearts of the criminals.

15:13.text: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.

15:14.text: if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,

15:15.text: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
